title: "Known ceilings"
page-layout: full

Every deliberate shortcut the code currently takes, what it limits, and what would lift it.
A ceiling is *lifted*, never deleted, so the history stays visible.

```{=html}
<table class="claims">

<tr id='k-002'><td class='cid-cell'>K-002</td><td>coupling-loop</td><td>dense Jacobian in the toy Newton solver (no band structure exploited)</td><td>about 200x slower than Picard per step on the toy problem (C-004)</td><td>banded Jacobian, once transport and pedestal models are confirmed local in radius</td><td><span class='badge st-open'>open</span></td></tr>
<tr id='k-003'><td class='cid-cell'>K-003</td><td>coupling-loop</td><td>fixed time step; no adaptive retry when a nonlinear step fails to converge</td><td>up to 6 non-converged steps in the ITER hybrid ramp-up at dt &lt;= 0.5 s; effect on stored energy 2e-5 relative (C-011)</td><td>adaptive dt with retry (owner decision OQ-5, 1 Oct 2026: keep TORAX&#x27;s line-search floor; stalls stay reported)</td><td><span class='badge st-open'>open</span></td></tr>
```
